game.name: Fight Night : Round 4 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De)
game.desc: Fight Night: Round 4 is a boxing game for Xbox 360 that allows you to play as the most powerful fighters of all time, such as Mike Tyson and Muhammad Ali. The animations are based on improved physics recreating a wide variety of punches, blocks and movements in the ring. Fatigue, adrenaline, footwork and timing must all be mastered if victory is to be achieved.
